function rightsParts(): object;

Defined in: core/locale/ui-text.ts:91

Segmented copyright line for the site footers — the same resolved rightsText() split around the © glyph and the year so renderers can wrap those two tokens in emphasis markup without hardcoding where the translation places them. post carries any suffix after the year (empty today, kept for translation freedom); when either anchor is missing the whole line lands in pre and renders unsegmented.
